title: NJ State Ethics Commission — Barry Jacobson — Decision — Dismissal (No. 008-14)
text:
STATE ETHICS COMMISSION
IN THE MATTER OF
BARRY JACOBSON,
ASSIST ANT DIRECTOR OF
INVESTIGATIONS,
OFFICE OF THE PUBLIC DEFENDER :
Commission Case No. 08-14
DECISION
This matter arises from an allegation that Barry Jacobson, Assistant Director of
Investigations with the Office of the Public Defender violated the Conflicts of Interest Law by
using his State position to influence school and local police offcials who were investigating
complaints that his son was the victim of bullying.
After considering the results of an investigation into the allegations against Barry
Jacobson, the Commission dismissed the matter pursuant to N.JA.C. 19:61-3.1(g).
DECISION RENDERED BY THE
STATE ETHICS COMMISSION ON
THE 21st DAY OF OCTOBER, 2014
